summary: Reserve notice source, snapshot and control namespaces and reviewed registration hashes before enabling notice facts.

replay.detail: Unreviewed reserved registrations are not trusted when custom projections rebuild.

schema.detail: Adds three compiled v1 custom storage manifests with exact serialized-byte SHA256 pins.

rules.detail: Reserved prefixes, prefix ancestors and notice claim kinds cannot be registered with substitute manifests. Reserved fact writes remain unavailable in this slice.

compatibility.detail: Generic custom list and detail reads no longer expose reserved raw notice rows, including legacy cache rows. Explicit reserved reads return notices-unavailable; unfiltered lists exclude them.

manual.detail: No notice publication is enabled by this change.

recovery.detail: Restore the reviewed manifest, not a substitute registration. Replicated admission ordering and revocation provenance remain a separate change.
